items.question: What is the monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer: The monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement is EUR 4,600. This is stated in Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement, which replaces the original monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000 [2].

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: How much notice is needed to terminate the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement can be terminated with sixty (60) days' written notice. [1]

There is no indication in the documents that this notice period has been amended. [3] does not alter the termination clause.

evidence.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.
Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement
